security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; worker-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Prepare and review image captions for LoRA training with halogen-flash-server
bundle.longDescription: ImageProc Halogen imports image collections, captions them with halogen-flash-server (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on AMD Strix Halo), and exports reviewed image-text pairs.
